title: Hearing on Legionnaires' disease and cooling tower safety
summary: The Council Committee on Health held an oversight hearing on the city's response to the 2026 Legionnaires' disease cluster, alongside consideration of several bills addressing cooling tower cleaning, testing, inspection and disease tracking. The bills would create testing sites and a digital map, a public hotline, tenant education materials and shower hoses, an interagency compliance review, and a public database of legionella-impacted locations. Testing during the 2026 Upper East Side cluster found 59 cooling towers with live Legionella bacteria out of 77 that initially tested positive.
